question: At what source depth and predictor rank does the L24H1 subject/entity V payload become causally usable?
claim: GW-V2 measures the held-out causal-effect-retention surface over a frozen source-depth by predictor-rank grid; it does not select or optimize a V predictor.
central_rule: Reconstruction accuracy is diagnostic; preservation of the inherited causal effect is the claim metric.

population.split_unit: resolved ISO-3166 alpha-3 subject country identity
population.train_use: predictor fitting and descriptive leave-one-subject-out surface only
population.validation_use: frozen-cell measurement only; no tuning, ranking, selection or grid change
population.test_use: frozen-cell measurement only; no tuning, ranking, selection or grid change
population.hypernym: out of scope; no mechanism-generalization claim

frozen_interface.query: natural final-position L24H1 Q from the target execution
frozen_interface.keys: GW-KEY-1 joint-arm template_id x source_role train reference direction at every source position, scaled to the target execution's natural K-row L2 norm
frozen_interface.subject_values: the sole varied component: exact natural L24H1 subject_entity V or the declared depth/rank predictor output
frozen_interface.other_values: GW-KEY-1 template_id x source_role train reference V direction outside subject_entity, scaled to the target execution's natural V-row L2 norm
frozen_interface.carrier_before: natural L24 carrier-before from the target execution
frozen_interface.other_heads: natural contributions from all seven non-H1 L24 attention heads
frozen_interface.attention: rerun real H1 score scaling, attention softcap and softmax, then weighted-V aggregation
frozen_interface.downstream: effective prepared-production Q8 W_O, canonical post-attention transform and residual write, L24 FFN and every later layer
dynamic_natural_inputs: every target natural source K-row norm
every target natural non-subject V-row norm
natural contributions from the seven non-H1 heads
frozen_interface.reason: natural carrier, other heads, Q and reference-bank row norms deliberately isolate V but retain full pre-L24 execution state

grid.construction: Cartesian product in source_depth major, rank minor order
grid.cell_status: every cell is a first-class result

predictor.family: centred ridge map followed by deterministic reduced-rank truncation
predictor.input: natural H1 subject_entity V at the declared source attention layer and frozen subject-token position
predictor.target: natural L24H1 subject_entity V at the identical subject-token position
predictor.fit_row: one equally weighted subject-token position per fresh-population execution
predictor.decomposition: full fitted weight SVD with deterministic sign canonicalization before rank truncation
predictor.train_prediction: leave-one-subject-out for descriptive train reporting only
predictor.heldout_artifact: one all-train-subject fit per source depth; five frozen rank truncations share that fit
forbidden_inputs: semantic target labels as predictor features or objectives
validation or test V tensors during fitting

controls.positive: exact natural L24H1 subject_entity V through the identical intervention machinery
controls.identity: captured exact subject_entity V reinserted through the intervention machinery
controls.fit_sham: subject-identity permutation within train relation strata, seed 27022031
controls.required_parity: identity/no-op proximal and terminal candidate logits are bit-exact with the bound natural reference path
controls.coverage: every cell, execution and subject-token position; no fallback or imputation

estimand.unit: semantic edge with three prompt-family repeated executions
estimand.same_fact: the three prompt families of one subject/relation/target
estimand.matched_control: different subject at the same split, relation and prompt family

surfaces.raw: restricted softmax over the 142 frozen fresh-population first-target-token candidates
surfaces.zscored: independently z-score each 142-logit row, then restricted softmax

estimand.denominator_refusal: refuse a split/surface ratio if the exact-arm point effect is non-positive
estimand.terminal_transport: repeat the adjusted raw and z-scored candidate effect at terminal logits
estimand.carrier: qualification only; cannot rescue a semantic-effect failure
estimand.reconstruction: cosine and MSE are diagnostic only; neither enters a claim gate

analysis.aggregate_scope: equal-weight factual relations capital, currency and language

bootstrap.method: resample subjects with replacement within each split and carry all three relations and all three prompt families
bootstrap.retention_family: all 35 cells x raw/zscored surfaces within one split
bootstrap.terminal_family: all 35 cells x raw/zscored terminal effects within one split
bootstrap.max_t: for each replicate take max over the family of (estimate - bootstrap_estimate) / bootstrap_standard_error; lower=estimate-q95(max_t)*bootstrap_standard_error

cell_gate.heldout_clearance: cell clears held out only if every gate passes independently on validation and test

early_frontier.purpose: preregistered region-level interpretation, not predictor selection
early_frontier.shape: one contiguous 2x2 tile in the frozen depth x rank grid
early_frontier.declaration: EARLY PAYLOAD FRONTIER EXISTS only if at least one such tile has all four cells heldout-clearing
early_frontier.coordinate_rule: report the qualifying tile with smallest upper depth, then smallest lower rank; descriptive only
early_frontier.isolated_cell: reported but cannot establish a frontier
early_frontier.failure: NO EARLY PAYLOAD FRONTIER ON THE FROZEN GRID

report_fields_per_cell: canonical work avoided under counterfactual composition

cost_model.source_prefix_boundary: embeddings plus complete canonical layers 0..d-1 plus layer d pre-attention normalization and required H1 V projection at subject positions
cost_model.actual_v2_replay: retains full natural pre-L24 state and therefore does not claim avoided execution
cost_model.constructor_cost: report isolated payload-construction work for later composition, separately from actual V2 replay cost
cost_model.shared_frontier: a successor executes common canonical prefix work once through the deepest component requirement; component costs are not naively summed
cost_model.avoided_work_rule: report candidate constructor work and counterfactual canonical work avoided, explicitly labelled as non-realized in V2
cost_model.efficiency_visualization: min(raw retention,zscored retention)/(payload-constructor shared-prefix cost/canonical L0-L23 cost)
cost_model.efficiency_visualization_use: visualization only; never a gate, ranking or selection metric

run_hygiene.measurement_resolution: strictly finer than every reported comparison

execution_order: validate frozen protocol and population identities
capture outcome-free natural Q/K/V, carrier, non-H1 and source-depth V tensors for all frozen rows
fit every declared depth/rank cell from train subjects only
seal all 35 predictor identities before any validation or test replay
execute all 35 cells and controls on validation and test without inspection-driven changes
adjudicate the complete surface and frozen frontier rule
hard_refusals: cell removal after any partial result
changed K or non-subject V reference treatment
changed natural carrier-before or non-H1 treatment
efficiency claim from the isolation replay

claim_boundary.pass_establishes: a causally useful L24H1 subject/entity V payload is available by a shallow frozen depth/rank region under the natural L24 execution environment
